SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM customers

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_products
FROM product_master
WHERE product_master.is_active = TRUE

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'

SELECT sales.payment_method AS payment_method, COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY orders DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE customers.is_prime = TRUE) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS prime_share, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM customers

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.order_id END), 0) AS aov
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'

SELECT date_trunc('month', sales.placed_at) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY month

SELECT product_master.category AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.category AS category, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.return_requested_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS return_rate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sales.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS delivered_lines
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT q.return_reason, q.returned_lines, q.returned_lines * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(q.returned_lines) OVER (), 0) AS returned_lines_share
FROM (SELECT sales.return_reason AS return_reason, COUNT(*) AS returned_lines
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.return_requested_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1) AS q
ORDER BY returned_lines DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN sales.payment_method = 'COD' THEN 'COD' ELSE 'Prepaid' END AS payment_type, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.rto_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.shipped_at IS NULL), 0) AS rto_rate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sales.shipped_at IS NOT NULL) AS shipped_lines
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rto_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT impressions.position AS list_position, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE impressions.clicked)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ctr, COUNT(*) AS impressions
FROM impressions
WHERE impressions.position <= 10.0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY ctr DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT inventory_live.sku_id AS sku_id, product_master.product_name AS product_name, product_master.category AS category, inventory_live.inbound_qty AS inbound_qty
FROM inventory_live
LEFT JOIN product_master ON inventory_live.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE inventory_live.on_hand_qty <= 0.0 AND product_master.is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4
LIMIT 100

SELECT campaigns.channel_group AS channel_group, campaigns.channel AS marketing_channel, SUM(marketing_spend.spend) AS spend
FROM marketing_spend
LEFT JOIN campaigns ON marketing_spend.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY spend DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.category AS category, (SUM(product_reviews.rating)) / NULLIF(COUNT(product_reviews.rating), 0) AS avg_rating, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE product_reviews.sentiment = 'Negative')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS negative_share, COUNT(*) AS reviews
FROM product_reviews
LEFT JOIN product_master ON product_reviews.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE product_reviews.moderation_status = 'Published'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT support_contacts.issue_category AS issue, COUNT(DISTINCT support_contacts.ticket_id) AS tickets, (SUM(support_contacts.csat)) / NULLIF(COUNT(support_contacts.csat), 0) AS avg_csat, (SUM(support_contacts.first_response_minutes)) / NULLIF(COUNT(support_contacts.first_response_minutes), 0) AS avg_first_response_minutes
FROM support_contacts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY tickets DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN sales.is_first_order THEN 'New' ELSE 'Repeat' END AS new_or_repeat, COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY orders DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT clickstream.device AS device, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN clickstream.event_type = 'purchase' THEN clickstream.session_id END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id), 0) AS conversion_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id) AS sessions
FROM clickstream
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sale_events.event_id AS event_id, sale_events.name AS sale_event, COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales
FROM sales
JOIN sale_events ON sales.placed_at >= sale_events.start_date AND sales.placed_at < sale_events.end_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sale_events.name IN ('Diwali 2025', 'Diwali 2026')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY orders DESC NULLS LAST

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT CAST(placed_at AS DATE) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_at IS NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales
  FROM sales WHERE line_type = 'Sale' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.event_id, e.name, CAST(e.start_date AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST(e.end_date AS DATE) AS end_date,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.day BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date), 0)
         / (date_diff('day', e.start_date, e.end_date) + 1) AS event_daily_net_sales,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.day BETWEEN e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY
                                            AND e.start_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY), 0) / 14 AS before_daily_net_sales,
       event_daily_net_sales / NULLIF(before_daily_net_sales, 0) - 1 AS lift
FROM sale_events e LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.day BETWEEN e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND e.end_date
WHERE e.end_date <= (SELECT MAX(day) FROM daily)
  AND e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY >= (SELECT MIN(day) FROM daily)
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name, e.start_date, e.end_date
ORDER BY lift DESC

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT c.channel, SUM(a.credit_last_click * a.order_revenue) AS last_click_revenue
  FROM marketing_attribution a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id GROUP BY 1),
spend AS (
  SELECT c.channel, SUM(m.spend) AS spend
  FROM marketing_spend m JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = m.campaign_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.channel, r.last_click_revenue, s.spend, r.last_click_revenue / NULLIF(s.spend, 0) AS roas_last_click
FROM spend s LEFT JOIN revenue r ON r.channel = s.channel
ORDER BY roas_last_click DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT campaigns.campaign_id AS campaign_id, campaigns.campaign_name AS campaign, marketing_attribution.channel_group AS channel_group, SUM(marketing_attribution.credit_last_click * marketing_attribution.order_revenue) AS last_click_revenue
FROM marketing_attribution
LEFT JOIN campaigns ON marketing_attribution.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
WHERE NOT marketing_attribution.campaign_id IS NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY last_click_revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

SELECT sales.courier AS courier, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST(sales.delivered_at AS DATE) > CAST(sales.promised_delivery_date AS DATE))) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS late_delivery_rate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sales.delivered_at IS NOT NULL) AS delivered_lines
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC NULLS LAST

WITH platform AS (
  SELECT c.channel, SUM(m.platform_conversions) AS platform_orders
  FROM marketing_spend m JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = m.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_group IN ('Paid Search', 'Paid Social', 'Display') GROUP BY 1),
shop AS (
  SELECT c.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS recorded_orders
  FROM sales s JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
  WHERE s.line_type = 'Sale' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT p.channel, p.platform_orders, sh.recorded_orders,
       p.platform_orders * 1.0 / NULLIF(sh.recorded_orders, 0) AS over_reporting
FROM platform p LEFT JOIN shop sh ON sh.channel = p.channel
ORDER BY over_reporting DESC NULLS LAST

WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(placed_at) AS first_at FROM sales WHERE line_type = 'Sale' GROUP BY 1),
eligible AS (
  SELECT customer_id, first_at FROM firsts
  WHERE first_at <= (SELECT MAX(placed_at) FROM sales) - INTERVAL 90 DAY),
again AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.customer_id FROM eligible e JOIN sales s ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id
  WHERE s.line_type = 'Sale' AND s.placed_at > e.first_at AND s.placed_at <= e.first_at + INTERVAL 90 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(a.customer_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_share, COUNT(*) AS buyers
FROM eligible e LEFT JOIN again a ON a.customer_id = e.customer_id

SELECT product_master.category AS category, product_skus.size AS size, SUM(inventory_history.lost_sales_units) AS lost_units, SUM(inventory_history.demand_units) AS demand_units, (SUM(inventory_history.lost_sales_units)) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SUM(inventory_history.demand_units)), 0) AS lost_share
FROM inventory_history
LEFT JOIN product_master ON inventory_history.product_id = product_master.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_skus ON inventory_history.sku_id = product_skus.sku_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY lost_units DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

SELECT product_master.category AS category, sales.size_fit AS size_fit, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.return_requested_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS return_rate, COUNT(*) AS delivered_lines
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND product_master.category IN ('Footwear', 'Apparel')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY return_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT CASE WHEN sales.event_id IS NULL THEN 'Normal day' ELSE 'Sale-event day' END AS day_type, (SUM((sales.mrp - sales.unit_price) * sales.quantity)) / NULLIF(SUM(sales.mrp * sales.quantity), 0) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_discount_pct DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customers.region AS region, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM customers
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY customers DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE tickets.resolution_status = 'Resolved')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ticket_resolution_rate
FROM ((SELECT ticket_id, MIN(contact_at) AS opened_at,
        arg_min(channel, contact_at) AS channel, arg_min(issue_category, contact_at) AS issue_category,
        arg_max(resolution_status, contact_at) AS resolution_status, COUNT(*) AS contacts
 FROM support_contacts GROUP BY ticket_id)) AS tickets

SELECT date_trunc('month', marketing_spend.date_hour) AS month, SUM(marketing_spend.spend) AS spend
FROM marketing_spend
WHERE marketing_spend.date_hour >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND marketing_spend.date_hour < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY month

SELECT sales.ship_city AS city, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.rto_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.shipped_at IS NULL), 0) AS rto_rate
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rto_rate DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

SELECT sellers.seller_type AS seller_type, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.cancelled_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS cancellation_rate
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN sellers ON sales.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT clickstream.traffic_source AS traffic_source, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN clickstream.event_type = 'purchase' THEN clickstream.session_id END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id), 0) AS conversion_rate
FROM clickstream
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.category AS category, (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL AND sales.refunded_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - sales.tax_amount - sales.shipping_fee - sales.unit_cost * sales.quantity END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL AND sales.refunded_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - sales.tax_amount - sales.shipping_fee END), 0) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT (SUM(product_reviews.rating)) / NULLIF(COUNT(product_reviews.rating), 0) AS avg_rating
FROM product_reviews
WHERE product_reviews.moderation_status = 'Published'

SELECT impressions.surface AS surface, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE impressions.clicked)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ctr
FROM impressions
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY ctr DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customer_addresses.region AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN customer_addresses ON sales.address_id = customer_addresses.address_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.sub_category AS sub_category, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.return_requested_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS return_rate
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND product_master.category = 'Apparel'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customers.is_prime AS prime, COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN customers ON sales.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY orders DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sales.device AS device, (SUM(CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.order_id END), 0) AS aov
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY aov DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sales.warehouse_id AS warehouse, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST(sales.delivered_at AS DATE) > CAST(sales.promised_delivery_date AS DATE))) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT campaigns.channel AS marketing_channel, (SUM(marketing_spend.spend) FILTER(WHERE campaigns.channel_group IN ('Paid Search', 'Paid Social', 'Display'))) / NULLIF(SUM(marketing_spend.clicks) FILTER(WHERE campaigns.channel_group IN ('Paid Search', 'Paid Social', 'Display')), 0) AS cpc
FROM marketing_spend
LEFT JOIN campaigns ON marketing_spend.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
WHERE campaigns.channel_group IN ('Paid Search', 'Paid Social', 'Display') AND marketing_spend.date_hour >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND marketing_spend.date_hour < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cpc DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT support_contacts.channel AS support_channel, (SUM(support_contacts.csat)) / NULLIF(COUNT(support_contacts.csat), 0) AS avg_csat
FROM support_contacts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_csat DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_reviews.aspect AS review_aspect, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE product_reviews.sentiment = 'Negative')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS negative_review_share
FROM product_reviews
LEFT JOIN product_master ON product_reviews.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE product_reviews.moderation_status = 'Published' AND product_master.category = 'Footwear'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY negative_review_share DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT date_trunc('month', clickstream.event_at) AS month, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN clickstream.event_type = 'purchase' THEN clickstream.session_id END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id), 0) AS conversion_rate
FROM clickstream
WHERE clickstream.event_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND clickstream.event_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY month

SELECT product_master.brand_name AS brand, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT CASE WHEN sales.payment_method = 'COD' THEN 'COD' ELSE 'Prepaid' END AS payment_type, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.cancelled_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS cancellation_rate
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT inventory_history.warehouse_id AS warehouse, SUM(inventory_history.lost_sales_units) AS lost_sales_units
FROM inventory_history
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY lost_sales_units DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT date_trunc('month', sales.placed_at) AS month, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales.is_first_order THEN sales.order_id END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id), 0) AS new_customer_order_share
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY month

SELECT impressions.position AS list_position, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE impressions.clicked)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS ctr
FROM impressions
WHERE impressions.surface = 'home_recs' AND impressions.position <= 5.0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY ctr DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.category AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_sold
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY units_sold DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sales.courier AS courier, (SUM(DATE_DIFF('HOUR', sales.placed_at, sales.delivered_at)) / 24.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(sales.delivered_at), 0) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT date_trunc('quarter', sales.placed_at) AS quarter, SUM(sales.gross_amount) AS gross_sales
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY quarter

SELECT product_master.gender AS product_gender, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.return_requested_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS return_rate
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND product_master.gender IN ('Women', 'Men')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY return_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT clickstream.traffic_source AS traffic_source, COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id) AS sessions
FROM clickstream
WHERE clickstream.event_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND clickstream.event_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY sessions DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT campaigns.channel_group AS channel_group, (SUM(marketing_spend.platform_revenue) FILTER(WHERE campaigns.channel_group <> 'CRM')) / NULLIF(SUM(marketing_spend.spend) FILTER(WHERE campaigns.channel_group <> 'CRM'), 0) AS platform_roas
FROM marketing_spend
LEFT JOIN campaigns ON marketing_spend.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
WHERE campaigns.channel_group NOT IN ('CRM')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY platform_roas DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT date_trunc('month', tickets.opened_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS support_tickets
FROM ((SELECT ticket_id, MIN(contact_at) AS opened_at,
        arg_min(channel, contact_at) AS channel, arg_min(issue_category, contact_at) AS issue_category,
        arg_max(resolution_status, contact_at) AS resolution_status, COUNT(*) AS contacts
 FROM support_contacts GROUP BY ticket_id)) AS tickets
WHERE tickets.opened_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND tickets.opened_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY month

SELECT support_contacts.channel AS support_channel, (SUM(support_contacts.first_response_minutes)) / NULLIF(COUNT(support_contacts.first_response_minutes), 0) AS avg_first_response_minutes
FROM support_contacts
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY avg_first_response_minutes DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.usage AS usage, (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL AND sales.refunded_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - sales.tax_amount - sales.shipping_fee - sales.unit_cost * sales.quantity END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL AND sales.refunded_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - sales.tax_amount - sales.shipping_fee END), 0) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customer_addresses.city_tier AS city_tier, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.rto_at IS NULL)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.shipped_at IS NULL), 0) AS rto_rate
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN customer_addresses ON sales.address_id = customer_addresses.address_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY rto_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customers.signup_channel AS traffic_source, COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM customers
WHERE customers.signup_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND customers.signup_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY customers DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT product_master.brand_name AS brand, (SUM((sales.mrp - sales.unit_price) * sales.quantity)) / NULLIF(SUM(sales.mrp * sales.quantity), 0) AS avg_discount_pct, SUM(sales.quantity) AS units
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND product_master.category = 'Footwear'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY units DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT impressions.surface AS surface, COUNT(*) AS impressions
FROM impressions
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY impressions DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customers.is_prime AS prime, (SUM(CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.order_id END), 0) AS aov
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN customers ON sales.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY aov DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT inventory_live.warehouse_id AS warehouse, SUM(inventory_live.on_hand_qty) AS on_hand_units
FROM inventory_live
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY on_hand_units DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT customer_addresses.region AS region, (COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE CAST(sales.delivered_at AS DATE) > CAST(sales.promised_delivery_date AS DATE))) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL), 0) AS late_delivery_rate
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN customer_addresses ON sales.address_id = customer_addresses.address_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY late_delivery_rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales.order_id) AS orders
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-12-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'

SELECT warehouses.city AS warehouse_city, SUM(inventory_live.on_hand_qty) AS units_on_hand, MAX(warehouses.capacity_units) AS capacity, (SUM(inventory_live.on_hand_qty)) * 1.0 / NULLIF((MAX(warehouses.capacity_units)), 0) AS capacity_used
FROM inventory_live
LEFT JOIN warehouses ON inventory_live.warehouse_id = warehouses.warehouse_id

       COALESCE(SUM(d.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.day BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date), 0)
         / (date_diff('day', e.start_date, e.end_date) + 1) AS event_daily_net_sales,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.day BETWEEN e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY

       event_daily_net_sales / NULLIF(before_daily_net_sales, 0) - 1 AS lift
FROM sale_events e LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.day BETWEEN e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND e.end_date
WHERE e.end_date <= (SELECT MAX(day) FROM daily)

  SELECT CAST(placed_at AS DATE) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_at IS NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_sales
  FROM sales WHERE line_type = 'Sale' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT e.event_id, e.name, CAST(e.start_date AS DATE) AS start_date, CAST(e.end_date AS DATE) AS end_date,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.day BETWEEN e.start_date AND e.end_date), 0)
         / (date_diff('day', e.start_date, e.end_date) + 1) AS event_daily_net_sales,
       COALESCE(SUM(d.net_sales) FILTER (WHERE d.day BETWEEN e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY
                                            AND e.start_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY), 0) / 14 AS before_daily_net_sales,
       event_daily_net_sales / NULLIF(before_daily_net_sales, 0) - 1 AS lift
FROM sale_events e LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.day BETWEEN e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND e.end_date
WHERE e.end_date <= (SELECT MAX(day) FROM daily)
  AND e.start_date - INTERVAL 14 DAY >= (SELECT MIN(day) FROM daily)
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.name, e.start_date, e.end_date
ORDER BY lift DESC

SELECT sales.traffic_source AS traffic_source, (SUM(CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales.cancelled_at IS NULL THEN sales.order_id END), 0) AS aov
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND sales.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND sales.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY aov DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sales.order_status AS order_status, COUNT(*) AS order_lines
FROM sales
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_lines DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id) FILTER (WHERE clickstream.event_type = 'pdp_view') AS product_view_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id) FILTER (WHERE clickstream.event_type = 'add_to_cart') AS add_to_cart_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT clickstream.session_id) FILTER (WHERE clickstream.event_type = 'purchase') AS purchase_sessions
FROM clickstream
WHERE clickstream.event_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-01' AND clickstream.event_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-11-01'

SELECT impressions.surface AS surface, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE impressions.added_to_cart = TRUE) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS add_to_cart_share
FROM impressions
WHERE impressions.shown_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND impressions.shown_at < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY add_to_cart_share DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT sale_events.event_type AS event_type, COUNT(*) AS events, AVG(sale_events.demand_uplift) AS avg_demand_uplift
FROM sale_events
WHERE sale_events.start_date IS NOT NULL AND sale_events.start_date >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND sale_events.start_date < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY events DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT marketing_spend.region AS region, SUM(marketing_spend.spend) AS spend, SUM(marketing_spend.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(marketing_spend.impressions) AS impressions, (SUM(marketing_spend.clicks)) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SUM(marketing_spend.impressions)), 0) AS ad_ctr
FROM marketing_spend
WHERE marketing_spend.date_hour >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND marketing_spend.date_hour < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY spend DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale' AND product_master.brand_name = 'ADIDAS'

SELECT product_master.category AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT sales.delivered_at IS NULL THEN sales.net_amount - COALESCE(sales.refund_amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS realized_revenue
FROM sales
LEFT JOIN product_master ON sales.product_id = product_master.product_id
WHERE sales.line_type = 'Sale'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY realized_revenue DESC NULLS LAST
